{{Top|leg}}
'''Byrothsis''' was a substance used to create [[Focusing lens/Legends|lenses]] for [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]] [[Camera/Legends|cameras]] and [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].<ref name="KOTOR2-Prima">[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> Natural byrothsis was extremely rare and expensive, but Synthetic byrothsis was developed by [[ResSystem]], creating a new industry based on applications of byrothsis. Several technological designs based on the use of byrothsis were condemned to the drawing boards for years until a cheap production method could be found; one the designs to utilize the synthetic byrothsis was the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Heat Sensor Trip|heat sensor trip]].<ref name="CRFG">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref>
